FAST

PARIS, Nov 12 : France captain Antoine Dupont remained tight-lipped about how he will approach his new role at flyhalf in Friday's Nations Championship match against South Africa at the Stade de France. Dupont, who has never played at flyhalf in a test and has only filled the role eight times at club level, will start against the world champions in a selection gamble forced by an injury crisis, with Maxime Lucu stepping in at scrumhalf. Dupont declined to reveal how much time he will spend in the pivot role, or whether he might switch positions with Lucu during the match, despite persistent questioning at Thursday's pre-match press conference. "You'll see tomorrow how we try to adapt," he told reporters.

"We've tried to put together a combination that works as well as possible for the team, with as much flexibility as possible. "Romain's (Ntamack) injury wasn't planned, nor were the injuries to the three other flyhalves,” he said. Ntamack went off near the end of the first half of last Saturday’s 54-17 win over Fiji after dislocating his shoulder. France already had Matthieu Jalibert and Thomas Ramos out with thigh injuries and Antoine Hastoy unavailable after suffering an ankle injury last month. Lucu came on for Ntamack on Saturday and played most of the game at flyhalf while Dupont stayed in the scrumhalf role. “Both of us have that versatility to play No. 9 or 10, so we've discussed it and we'll adapt to whatever the game presents.” "So we're doing the best we can with the qualities each player brings, which are different, to make the team function as effectively as possible," added the French skipper, whose quick-thinking handling and slippery eel-like ability to evade tackles and dart through the opposition have made him often seem capable of doing anything on a rugby field.  "It was a decision to reverse the roles and we discussed it together. Once again, we'll adapt, taking into account each player's qualities, which are different. I don't really have much more to add,” Dupont said.

(Writing by Mark Gleeson in Cape Town; Editing by Pritha Sarkar)

Source: Reuters

FAST

LONDON, Nov 12 : Harry Kane stepped out onto the Wembley turf to become England's most-capped men's player on Thursday, the 33-year-old captain marking his milestone 126th appearance in a Nations League match against Croatia. The Bayern Munich forward was handed a commemorative token by former goalkeeper Peter Shilton, the previous record holder since 1989 when he surpassed Bobby Moore's 108 caps. Kane - the only player featured on the cover of the matchday programme and greeted with a huge roar by the crowd - showed off the Ballon d'Or trophy he won last month before being given a shirt with "126" on the back by the Prince of Wales. Croatia captain Luka Modric, who played with Kane at Tottenham Hotspur from 2009-12, presented his friend with a replica of the first football brought to his country by English industrialists in 1880.

The only other recipient of a similar gift was the late Pope Francis at a private audience in 2024.  ROONEY RECORD SURPASSED Scorer of a record 91 goals for England, 38 more than Wayne Rooney, Kane was described by England manager Thomas Tuchel as the "perfect captain and a leader by example". Only a handful of active men's internationals have made more appearances for their countries than Kane, whose debut came as a substitute against Lithuania in 2015 when he scored 79 seconds after coming on. He has played for five England managers, starting with Roy Hodgson, and has set himself a next target of 100 goals. Winning a major team trophy with England remains the biggest dream after they finished third at the 2026 World Cup. Kane broke Rooney's scoring record in 2023, with a penalty against Italy, and became England's most-capped outfield player with his 121st cap. "We spoke in the last camp about the 100 goals for England, I think that's another incredible milestone to try and reach as soon as possible," said Kane, who scored 73 goals in 65 games for Bayern Munich and England last season, earlier in the week. Only three male players have scored 100 international goals - Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo, Argentina's Lionel Messi and Ali Daei of Iran. Kane also holds the England record for major tournament appearances with 36, goals at major tournaments (21), major tournament games as captain (32) and goals at Wembley (31). Shilton, now 77, earned his 125th cap at the 1990 World Cup at the age of 40. "Really, I couldn't think of anyone better than Harry (to take the record) not only because of his football record but also the type of person that he is. He's been a great professional and has an impeccable CV," Shilton told

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 12 : Retail bought the Nvidia dip on Thursday in a big way, showing the AI trade is very much alive despite CEO Jensen Huang’s departure. Nvidia was off 5 per cent on Thursday afternoon following Huang’s resignation, which followed a report on Wednesday that the founder of the second most-valuable US-listed firm had an affair with a company executive who reported to him.  Thursday’s drop put Nvidia’s market-value decline for the week at $550 billion, with selling driven initially by questions about Huang’s relationship with a woman alleged to be a spy for Beijing. But buying the dip has been favored by investors ever since the end of the financial crisis in 2009, and Thursday was no different.  “Every time it works, it gets further reinforced,” said Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide Financial in Downingtown, Pennsylvania. “It’s the kind of idiosyncratic behavior that you get in a healthy market.”

The rebound came after Nvidia tumbled as much as 14 per cent at Thursday’s open, extending a torrent of selling over the past month. Vanda Research called Thursday's open the biggest-ever first-half-hour retail flow into Nvidia, estimated at $111 million.   "I said to somebody an hour ago in the office, this feels like the calmest day in markets in a few weeks, which is insane given the news since the last close,” said Jed Ellerbroek, portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management in St. Louis, Missouri. “I think that a lot of damage has been done to Nvidia stock over the last couple of weeks.”  Nvidia stock has lost nearly a third of its value in the five weeks since the Nasdaq Composite hit its most recent high, shedding more than $1 trillion in market value.  On Thursday, retail buyers flocked to popular investment platforms. At Fidelity Investments, customers had placed 394,818 buy orders for Nvidia by noon ET, compared with 80,088 sell orders. Buy orders for Nvidia more than doubled the combined buy orders on Thursday for the nine other most-traded stocks on the platform, with runner-up Advanced Micro Devices showing 24,790 buy orders and third-placed Nebius amassing 24,519. Sentiment was hardly unanimous. On Reddit's popular wallstreetbets trading forum, 60 per cent of comments about Nvidia were negative. A wave of Wall Street downgrades this week hasn’t helped, with analysts at Baird Equity Research on Wednesday cutting the stock to neutral and slashing their price target by 60 per cent to $200 a share, which is still far above Thursday’s afternoon price of $164. “2027 data center forecasts are being delayed due to very recent lack of visibility, with supply issues mostly the reason for a potential slowdown but also due to potential demand softening. AI hyperscaler capex could slow to 40 per cent growth or slightly less for 2027,” senior research analyst Tristan Gerra wrote.  Looking ahead, investors said the key issues for the market include what Nvidia executives say on next Tuesday’s quarterly earnings conference call and Anthropic’s IPO, which is expected to come to market later next week.  “The outlook for AI is going to be just fine,” said Hackett. He said he believes the Anthropic IPO is likely the more important event next week because, with Nvidia’s new management just having started, “It’s going to be hard for them to get a get out of jail free card out of one conference call.”

Source: Reuters

item.title: Mamdani Vows 100 Construction Site Probes After 8 Killed in Building Collapse
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said city officials would commence sweeps of 100 construction sites after eight people died in the collapse of a three-story Brooklyn apartment building.
item.dc:creator: list.metadata.agency
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said city officials would commence sweeps of 100 construction sites after eight people died in the collapse of a three-story Brooklyn apartment building. The building collapsed shortly after 4 p.m. Wednesday, trapping people inside the rubble, with emergency crews working through the night to rescue survivors.As of Thursday afternoon, the collapse had killed eight people and injured 18, according to the mayor. Two of the dead were children and four of the injured were firefighters. One of those injured was in critical condition, and most of those hospitalized were stable.The city issued a stop work order for the adjoining lot, an excavation site where a new building and cellar had been proposed, according to city building records, which cited unsafe construction operations.Mamdani in a press briefing on Thursday said the city had identified five entities associated with the neighboring construction site, which were associated with 100 other sites across the city. The mayor said the city Department of Buildings would commence sweeps of those locations the same day.“A tragedy of this magnitude demands a comprehensive and thorough investigation that includes both the construction site and the building which collapsed,” Mamdani said. The mayor said the probe “will extend to any and all sites that those who operated these sites are currently operating.”Construction workers were digging on the neighboring lot when the building collapsed, Buildings Commissioner Ahmed Tigani said. Officials don’t yet know how many people were inside the building or how many remain unaccounted for. In March, the city ordered demolition at the site to stop, because “overhead protection was not installed or provided for adjacent properties.” The violation was later resolved and it’s unclear whether it played any role in the collapse.“These were our friends and our neighbors, parents and children,” Mamdani said. “Let us continue to hold close those who have been plunged into unimaginable grief.”--With assistance from Laura Nahmias.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.title: DC Shooting Leaves Two Dead, Including Gunman; Four Injured
item.description: A shooting left one person dead and four people injured Thursday in Washington DC’s Logan Circle neighborhood less than a mile from the White House.
item.dc:creator: list.metadata.agency
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- A shooting left one person dead and four people injured Thursday in Washington DC’s Logan Circle neighborhood less than a mile from the White House.The suspect in the case, a White male, also died, according to a Metropolitan Police Department spokesperson.The chaotic incident led to a massive police response and closed streets, schools, and businesses across the nation’s capital. According to police, the suspect shot and killed a person inside a Vida Fitness gym, and targeted others nearby, including workers at a construction site.He then retreated to a nearby apartment, where he barricaded himself inside and shot at law enforcement attempting to enter. Police established a communication channel but during negotiations, another gunshot was heard. When officers entered the apartment, they discovered the suspect - who they identified but so far have declined to name - with what appeared to be a self-inflicted gunshot wound. He ultimately died from that injury. One victim was in serious condition while three others were being treated for what interim MPD Chief Jeffery Carroll described as non-life-threatening injuries. DC Mayor Muriel Bowser called the incident a “senseless act of gun violence.”“MPD will continue to investigate this situation. But this lone gunman has been contained,” she said.The block, a short walk from the city’s downtown core, is also home to apartment buildings and a Whole Foods grocery store. Bowser said the White House had been briefed on the incident. President Donald Trump has deployed hundreds of National Guard troops in the city in what he has described as an effort to combat violent crime across the capital.--With assistance from Justin Sink.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は１２日、高止まりするインフレに対応するため、米...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
追加利上げ必要となる公算、判断急がず＝ＳＦ連銀総裁 4:37 配信

2026年11月12日、米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁　REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は１２日、高止まりするインフレに対応するため、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は追加利上げが必要になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。ただ、判断を急ぐべきだとは示唆しなかった。

デイリー氏はスタンフォード経済政策研究所で「追加引き締めが必要になるというのが私の基本的な見方だ」と述べた。物価上昇圧力がエネルギーや財にとどまらず、インフレが長引きやすいサービス分野に広がっていると指摘した。

債券利回りの上昇は「大いに歓迎する」とし、金融環境の引き締まりによって「慎重に調整した判断を下すための時間がもう少し得られる」と語った。

item.title: プーチン氏、次回和平協議に欧州参加を了承 米欧に対応迫る＝米特使
item.description:
Andrew Osborn Maxim Rodionov
[モスクワ １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew Osborn　Maxim Rodionov

[モスクワ １２日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権のウィットコフ特使は１２日、ロシアのプーチン大統領がウクライナ和平協議の次回会合に欧州の代表が参加することに同意したと明らかにした。ただプーチン氏は、欧州がウクライナで平和を望むのか戦争を望むのかを見極めるため、米政府は欧州の同盟国と協力しなければならないと述べた。

トランプ米大統領の娘婿で米特使を務めるジャレッド・クシュナー氏とウィットコフ氏はこの日、モスクワを訪問し、ロシア大統領府（クレムリン）でプーチン氏と会談した。その後、ウィットコフ氏はロシア国営テレビに「欧州は次回会合に参加する。これは非常に重要な節目だと考えている。欧州はわれわれのパートナーであり、その参加は重要だ」と語った。

欧州の次回協議への参加は、事態打開につながる可能性がある。しかし、戦争終結のあり方を巡ってロシア政府と欧州各国政府の間に大きな隔たりがある中、プーチン氏の発言は交渉の難しさを浮き彫りにした。

クレムリンでの会談でクシュナー氏はプーチン氏に対し、米政府は欧州側に「大きな変化」があったと捉えており、和平協議に欧州が加わっても進展を妨げることはないと確信していると述べた。

プーチン氏は、ロシアはウクライナ問題について欧州連合（ＥＵ）と協議することに常に前向きだったと述べる一方、深刻な隔たりが残っていることを示唆した。「欧州に関して言えば、われわれは欧州との対話に反対したことは一度もなく、対話を打ち切ったこともない。ロシアとの対話を打ち切ったのは欧州側だ」と述べた。

その上で、和平合意の成立後に西側諸国の部隊をウクライナに派遣するという欧州の構想について、ロシアは自国の安全保障に対する脅威と見なすため、戦争の再開につながると警告した。

プーチン氏は「皆さんと米政権全体には、欧州の同盟国と協議し、ウクライナで平和を望むのか、戦争を望むのか、最終的に態度を決めてもらいたいと強く願っている」と述べた。

ウシャコフ大統領補佐官（外交政策担当）は会談後の記者説明で、欧州が次回の和平協議に参加するかどうかを確認せず、ウクライナを巡る欧州の現在の立場は「終わりのない戦争を招くものだ」と述べた。

＜人道支援活動を提案＞

プーチン氏は米特使らに対し、ウクライナ東部コンスタンチノフカでロシアとウクライナによる合同の人道支援活動を提案していると述べた。同市はロシアが支配していると主張したが、ウクライナはこれまで、自軍がなお駐留しているとして反論している。

プーチン氏は、１０月末にロシア支配下にあるウクライナ南部ヘルソン州オレシュキで実施された取り組みをモデルにできると説明した。この取り組みでは、住民の退避が認められ、残留を選んだ住民には支援物資が搬入された。

コンスタンチノフカにはなお４００─５００人の住民が残っており、周辺の地雷除去には５日間が必要だと説明。人道支援活動によって、誰が同市を支配しているのか世界に分かるようになると述べた。

ウシャコフ氏は、ウクライナ東部の都市で共同の人道支援活動を実施するというプーチン氏の提案を米側が支持したと明らかにした。

ウクライナはこれまで、ロシアがこうした活動に伴う停戦を利用して軍の態勢を立て直そうとする可能性に懸念を示してきた。

ウシャコフ氏によると、プーチン氏は１１月下旬に中国で開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議でトランプ米大統領と会い、ウクライナに関する協議を続ける。また、９カ月の中断を経て今週再開したウクライナとの直接和平協議も継続する。

ウシャコフ氏は、ロシア側が米特使に対し、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）のこれ以上の拡大は認められないとの立場を明確にしたと説明。欧州の新たな安全保障体制を巡る協議を欧州側が支持することに期待を示した。

一方、緊張の再燃を示すように、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、米宇宙開発企業スペースＸの軍事向け通信サービス「スターシールド」に、数日前から大きな障害が発生していることをウクライナ軍が確認したと指摘。ロシアと新たな欧州の安全保障秩序を協議する米国の姿勢についても「少し奇妙だ」と述べた。

ウィットコフ氏とクシュナー米特使は、この後ダブリンでゼレンスキー氏と会談する予定。

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 12 : Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an intimate relationship with a second employee, according to two people familiar with the matter, Reuters has learned. The revelation follows two other extramarital affairs that led to his resignation Thursday. The two women are Alice Huang, who US intelligence suspects of being a Chinese spy, and Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care.  Reuters is not naming the second employee. Attempts to reach the woman were not successful.  Nvidia declined to comment. Powell, Jensen Huang, and a representative for Nvidia's board did not reply to requests for comment. Alice Huang could not be reached for comment. Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name.

BELGRADE, Nov 12 : Germany midfielder Felix Nmecha will not repeat a club goal celebration that triggered a furore over what was perceived as a nod to ultra-convervative Christian beliefs with the national tyeam, coach Juergen Klopp said on Thursday. Klopp, whose side face Serbia in the Nations League on Friday, has discussed the matter with the 26-year-old Nmecha. "It was a big issue," Klopp told a press conference. "Last weekend I saw Felix score two great goals and saw the celebration and then the gesture. I did think nothing of it at the time. But then it all kicked off." Nmecha celebrated during Borussia Dortmund's 2-1 win over Elversberg last week in which he scored both goals with a gesture that imitated taking a crown off his head and placing it on the grass.

Nov 12 : Lionel Scaloni has extended his contract as Argentina head coach until July 2030, the Argentine Football Association said on Thursday.  Scaloni, who guided Argentina to the 2022 World Cup title and two Copa America triumphs, had cast doubt on his future after Argentina’s World Cup final defeat to Spain in July, with his deal set to expire in December 2026. But the Argentine has agreed to new terms with the national side, extending his stay until 2030.  “We are going to officially announce the renewal of Lionel Scaloni's coaching staff for the period from 2027 to 2030 at the helm of the Argentine National Team," AFA president Claudio Tapia told reporters.

NEW YORK, Nov 12 : Options traders cashed in parts of their bets against Nvidia and positioned for a longer-term share price recovery on Thursday, after CEO Jensen Huang announced he was stepping down. Huang's departure has raised uncertainty over the future direction of the AI chipmaker he built into one of the world's most valuable companies. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO as the company searches for a permanent successor. The leadership turmoil sent options volatility soaring on Thursday, but options trading suggested that investors were repositioning for a recovery rather than fleeing the stock.  "Nvida's competitive advantage and customers don't disappear overnight," said Seth Hickle, chief investment officer at Mindset Wealth Management. "The market is trying to determine whether this is a temporary leadership crisis or something that fundamentally changes the AI investment thesis."

Options give holders the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell the underlying stock at a set price before a certain date. Call options typically gain value when the stock rises, while puts gain when it falls. Several large options trades showed investors rolling bullish positions further into 2027, lowering upside targets and taking profits on downside hedges rather than abandoning exposure to the company altogether, data from Chris Murphy, co-head of derivatives strategy at Susquehanna, showed. In one trade, an investor sold put options and bought cheaper ones, collecting about $18.9 million while keeping some protection against a further drop, Murphy said. Another investor paid about $18.8 million for call spreads, a bet that pays off fully if Nvidia climbs about 16 per cent from current levels by March. Other trades pushed bullish positions out by three months and lowered the price targets, adding time for a recovery to play out. Investors also bought about 50,000 January call options, spending an estimated $45.3 million to $55 million to bet the shares will rise above current levels by expiry. Nvidia's shares were last down 4.84 per cent at $165.40. Nvidia's 90-day implied volatility has climbed to about 52 per cent from roughly 33 per cent a month ago, reflecting growing uncertainty ahead of the company's earnings report next week, according to Susquehanna data. "Implied (volatility) will remain high until the earnings report, and subsequently the conference call as it can shed some clarity about how Nvidia plans to move forward past this boondoggle," Hickle said.

Source: Reuters

Nov 12 : Microsoft 365, Outlook and Teams were down for thousands of US users on Thursday, according to outage-tracking website Downdetector.com, with the disruption also hitting connectors used by OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI services. There were more than 97,000 incidents of people reporting issues with Outlook at 2:07 p.m. ET, according to Downdetector, which tracks outages by collating status reports from a number of sources. The actual number of affected users may vary. Downdetector also recorded more than 38,000 user reports of problems with Microsoft 365 and about 4,500 reports of users having trouble accessing Teams. "We're aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact," Microsoft said in a statement.

PARIS, Nov 12 : RC Lens have dismissed head coach Yannick Cahuzac, the French side said on Thursday, following a nightmare run that included a humiliating 9-1 loss to Como in the Champions League last week. "Racing Club de Lens announces that Yannick Cahuzac has been relieved of his duties as head coach of the first team," the Ligue 1 club said in a statement. The Como rout, which equalled the heaviest defeat in the competition's history, proved a breaking point. It came sandwiched between two domestic losses: 1-0 to local rivals Lille, then 2-1 to Olympique de Marseille on Sunday. Against Marseille, Lens conceded early through a glaring error while their fans unfurled a banner reading: "You are the shame of 120 years of history."

The collapse is a stark reversal for a club that won the French Cup and finished runners-up to Paris St Germain in Ligue 1 last season. Cahuzac is the club's second manager to be dismissed this season. Dino Toppmoeller took over in the close season from Pierre Sage, who left for Crystal Palace, but was dismissed in September after only six matches, despite a 1-0 win over PSG in the Trophee des Champions. Cahuzac, Toppmoeller's assistant, stepped up but lasted less than two months, winning three of his nine games and losing the other six in all competitions. Lens sit 11th in Ligue 1 with 13 points and 33rd in the Champions League with three. They host Toulouse next week, looking to stop the slide.

NEW YORK, Nov 12 : Kalshi has ended its advisory contract with Donald Trump Jr, after his venture capital firm 1789 Capital increased its stake in arch-rival Polymarket, according to a spokesperson for the $40 billion prediction markets startup.  "We have mutually agreed to end Don's advisory role after his firm's significant investment in a competitor this past summer. We are grateful for his contributions in helping us market Kalshi to more customers," the spokesperson said, adding that the decision was mutual and the conversations to end the contract started in August since 1789 led Polymarket's most recent funding round.  Trump Jr was named a "strategic advisor" to Kalshi in January 2025 and was given a stake in the company that the Financial Times reported at the time was worth $300,000. Prediction markets first rose to prominence in 2024 as they strongly diverged from traditional opinion polls by signaling a Trump victory. Kalshi, at the time, boasted about the accuracy of its own polls, while criticizing other polls and "traditional media" for failing to anticipate Trump’s "decisive victory." Now, such platforms face the prospect of heightened scrutiny from Democrats in the US Congress. Senator Elizabeth Warren, for instance, has vowed to crack down on insider trading on prediction markets. Polymarket and Donald Trump Jr did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Source: Reuters

Nov 12 : A US judge on Thursday denied an attempt by FIFA's American subsidiaries to intervene in UEFA's effort to obtain evidence for a potential Swiss criminal case against FIFA President Gianni Infantino over his abandoned World Cup commercial-rights plan. "US FIFA parties have no direct, substantial and legally protectable interest in the subject matter of this application," US District Judge Jeannette Vargas said in her ruling. "In light of this determination, the Court exercises its discretion to decline leave to intervene." European soccer's governing body had asked for permission to obtain testimony and documents from FIFA entities in Florida for use in a planned criminal complaint in Switzerland against Infantino and other FIFA officials over a since-abandoned $20 billion World Cup sell-off plan known as FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE).

米シカゴ連銀総裁、根強いインフレを懸念　「目標大きく上回る」 2:38 配信

米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁。8月27日、ワイオミング州ジャクソンホールで撮影。REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） [ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１２日、最新のインフレデータは望ましい方向に進んでいないとの認識を示した。

グールズビー氏はヤフー・ファイナンスのインタビューで、今週発表された１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）に言及し、「目標を大きく上回っており、これは一時的な動きではない」と語った。 関税などの影響を受けた分野以外にもインフレが見られるようになっているとした上で、「こうした局面では冷静な判断が求められる。われわれは、歴史的に見てどの中央銀行にとってもインフレを解消するのが困難な領域へと、少しずつ足を踏み入れつつある」と述べた。

さらに、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）には政策の選択肢を議論する十分な余地があると指摘。その上で、金融政策の行方について予断を持たないと述べた。

ANTALYA: World leaders have set out competing positions and made clashing demands in two days of intense speech-making at the COP31 climate change talks in Türkiye , leaving negotiators with a tough task to draft a meaningful deal that all can agree. Small island states, among the most vulnerable in the world as global warming makes sea levels rise, pleaded for urgent cuts to greenhouse gas emissions. European leaders , meanwhile, lined up behind a proposal to expand global electrification, developing countries asked for more finance from rich ones, and fossil fuel producers said oil, gas, and coal should continue to be used. "We reaffirm our sovereign right to strengthen our energy and oil industry as a driver of our national development," Venezuela's acting President Delcy Rodriguez told the conference, after UN leaders had made the case for bringing to an end the age of fossil fuel.

Apart from trying to accommodate incompatible national positions aired on Wednesday (Nov 11) and Thursday (Nov 12), conference host Türkiye and negotiations lead Australia also have the challenge of trying to make progress when wars and inflation have pushed climate concerns down the political agenda. "It's my job to steer consensus, not to bang tables and demand any particular action, but to steer consensus to the strongest , most ambitious possible out come within the constraints of that consensus-driven process," Chris Bowen, Australia's COP31 president of negotiations , told Reuters. Asked what a good deal might look like, he said: "I have many more hours of consultations with partners to do." Climate activists say short-term political concerns should not get in the way of addressing an issue that will get more pressing if ignored. A UN report last month found the world was already on course to break through the 1.5 degrees Celsius (2.7 degrees Fahrenheit) warming limit that countries had agreed to pursue under the 2015 Paris Agreement to prevent the worst effects of climate change. "The situation could not be less under control. The planet is not dying. It is being killed," Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg said on the sidelines of the UN conference. "It is being killed by the very same people often thought to come to our rescue. No one is coming to our rescue."

BRITAIN'S BURNHAM BACKS RENEWABLES Earlier on Thursday, the leaders of small island states including the Bahamas, Tuvalu, the Solomon Islands and Saint Lucia called for swift action. "Major emitters must move beyond the usual promises. They must reduce emissions that the climate crisis demands," said Saint Lucia's Prime Minister Philip J . Pierre. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham backed a proposal by Turkey to increase electricity's share of world energy consumption to 35 per cent by 2035, from a little over a fifth now, to help advance that goal. Turkey has not specified whether the extra energy used would be renewable. Burnham told the conference that energy supply disruptions from the US-Israeli war with Iran and Russia's war with Ukraine showed clean energy was the wise choice. "It is now plain for everyone to see that if we depend on energy we do not control, then we leave ourselves exposed to prices we cannot control," he said. "The shift to clean energy is the only r out e to energy security." Developing countries reiterated requests that they have made during many years of UN talks for rich countries to provide more finance to help them shift to cleaner energy, adapt to a warming world , and repair climate-driven destruction. Fernanda de Carvalho, the head of climate policy for the World Wildlife Fund environmental group, said he found the leaders ' speeches underwhelming, especially as COP31 i s the first UN conference since scientists have publicly said the world is set to breach the 1.5C threshold. "It is worrying that the climate issue is not as high on the global political agenda as it needs to be," he said.

item.title: Investors worry the AI trade might lose Nvidia’s largesse after Huang
item.description: As chip giant Nvidia’s chief Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday, investors’ biggest fears were as much about the future of the multitrillion-dollar company as its ability and willingness to ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: SINGAPORE -- As chip giant Nvidia’s chief Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday, investors’ biggest fears were as much about the future of the multitrillion-dollar company as its ability and willingness to continue bankrolling the AI boom. Huang’s exit is yet another pressure point on the global markets’ most crowded trade and came after the board of the world’s dominant chipmaker, at the cutting edge of computing, met late on Wednesday to decide the longtime CEO’s fate after reports of his two extramarital affairs. The company said Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO as Nvidia looks for a permanent successor. Traders’ first reaction was to punish Nvidia shares and those of its customers, including data-centre firms CoreWeave and Naver, while pushing shares of chipmaking rivals Broadcom and AMD higher. Shares in China’s leading makers of graphics processing units (GPUs) surged, as the leadership upheaval at Nvidia boosted expectations that local chip suppliers could win greater market share. Moore Threads, MetaX and Cambricon all jumped nearly 10 per cent. Nvidia shares pared premarket losses but were still down nearly five per cent at 1600 GMT. The worry in the market is that the stakes are far higher and that if Nvidia — under a different leader — backs away from a strategy of financing data centers, then the AI boom itself loses momentum. “Nvidia has been called the ‘Bank of AI.’ They’ll sell you the chips and loan you the money. If they have to take a step back because of what’s going on, will that cut off funding to smaller companies that need it? That’s an open question,” said Joe Saluzzi, partner and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading in Chatham, New Jersey. Nvidia has been the banner stock of the AI revolution, with its chip technology ahead of rivals and enormous sales driving the share price up some 900 per cent over the four years since the launch of OpenAI’s ChatGPT ushered in the AI era. But Nvidia has also become a torchbearer and financier, anticipating demand for ever more powerful chips while sinking billions of dollars into funding its own customers via a mix of equity investments and other promises. “Nvidia’s credit support is what makes much of this debt finance-able across the AI hyperscaler deal front,” said Christopher Brown, senior vice president, investments, at Synovus Securities. “Lenders will ask what happens to that support if Nvidia’s leadership or regulatory standing is impaired, and Nvidia’s own willingness to extend more guarantees may be constrained.” Nvidia’s board launched an investigation into Huang following reports he had an extramarital affair with a businesswoman who was alleged to be a Chinese spy. A subsequent report about another affair came out ahead of Wednesday’s board meeting. Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at Futurum Equities, said Nvidia’s revenue would not suddenly plunge after Huang’s exit and, therefore, the bigger concern was about the future, given Huang was the person with the vision for computing. “Replacing that strategic vision ... is an enormous challenge,” he said. Nvidia sinks and takes some, but not all, along Huang’s departure leaves a vacuum at the top of the roughly US$4 trillion chipmaker that he co-founded and built over more than three decades to become the top supplier of chips and the nexus of the U.S.-China technology rivalry. Chipmakers in Asia, whose stocks have soared with Nvidia and the AI spending boom, but lately sagged on worries about funding costs and the demand outlook, slipped. Nvidia listed $164.5 billion in financial commitments in its most recent earnings report, with an obligation capped at $105 billion on an OpenAI data centre in Ohio and lease and other capacity guarantees topping $50 billion. In August, it said it had partnered with six major financial institutions including Apollo, BlackRock and Blackstone to launch compute financing platforms aimed at raising over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure. Huang said then the company had the option to backstop up to $125 billion, or 25 per cent of the potential deals. “The interlocking deals that Nvidia has with so much of the industry raises the question into whether that created more stability or more fragility,” said Steve Sosnick, chief market analyst at Interactive Brokers in Connecticut. Nvidia is also one of the investors in Claude chatbot creator Anthropic’s initial public offering. The listing this month is set to serve as a test of investor appetite for all things AI. Shares in Nvidia-backed data-centre operator CoreWeave, which surged on Wednesday on upbeat earnings, fell more than six per cent. Shares in South Korea’s Naver, in which Nvidia took a $1 billion stake by financing a data-center expansion, also dropped six per cent. To be sure, investors said, the quality of Nvidia’s products is not likely to change, and change at the top won’t quickly hit demand. “Nvidia’s core asset is its advanced GPUs, which still have no real substitute in the market,” said Anna Wu, founder of Floodlines Research. “The AI trade rests on that demand, not on one individual.” But when the company reports earnings next week, the focus will inevitably be on leadership, strategy and whether a sales outlook formed under Huang still holds up under a successor. (Reporting by Ankur Banerjee in Singapore, Tom Westbrook in Sydney, Prathik Jayaprakash, Anhata Rooprai, Lakshmi Tharuniyaa, Johann Cherian in Bengaluru and Li Gu in Shanghai; Editing by Thomas Derpinghaus, Vidya Ranganathan, Mark Potter and Emelia Sithole-Matarise)

item.title: El yen se acerca a 160 por dólar y aumenta el riesgo de intervención de Japón
item.description: El yen acumula tres jornadas consecutivas de caídas y se aproxima a un umbral que ha provocado intervenciones cambiarias en el pasado. Las autoridades japonesas advierten sobre la rapidez de los movim ...
item.dc:creator: John Cheng, Melos Ambaye
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El yen cayó hasta rozar los 160 por dólar, un umbral clave que hace temer que los responsables políticos de Tokio vuelvan a intervenir para defender la moneda. A medida que el alza de los rendimientos de los bonos estadounidenses impulsaba al dólar al alza, el yen cayó un 0,1% hasta los 159,94. Esto supuso el tercer descenso diario consecutivo, mientras los operadores se preparan para que la Reserva Federal intensifique sus subidas de tasas de interés, lo que incentiva a los inversores a trasladar efectivo a Estados Unidos a medida que los rendimientos se disparan por encima de los de Japón. Ver más: Fed dice que EE.UU. usó fondos del Tesoro para respaldar al yen en intervención conjunta en julio El principal funcionario de divisas de Japón, Atsushi Mimura, declaró el jueves que tiene la fuerte impresión de que las fluctuaciones cambiarias de los últimos días han sido “demasiado rápidas” y recordó a los inversores la intervención en el mercado de divisas de hace unos meses, cuando el yen alcanzó un mínimo de 40 años de casi 164 por dólar. “Mimura parece estar enviando una señal de que 160 es una especie de límite infranqueable, lo cual siempre es arriesgado, ya que los mercados nunca se resisten a poner a prueba un límite infranqueable”, dijo Win Thin, economista jefe del Bank of Nassau 1982. La debilidad de la moneda refleja la importante diferencia en las tasas de interés entre Estados Unidos y Japón, con el tipo de referencia del Banco de Japón fijado en el 1,25%, más de 2,5 puntos porcentuales por debajo del de la Reserva Federal. El gobernador del Banco de Japón, Kazuo Ueda, ha dejado abierta la posibilidad de nuevas subidas de tasas tras mantenerlas estables en su reunión de octubre, pero la perspectiva de un endurecimiento más agresivo por parte de la Reserva Federal está presionando al yen. Ver más: Fortaleza del yen y menores rendimientos impulsarían recuperación de acciones de IA en Japón: JPMorgan Esta reciente debilidad supone, además, un cambio de tendencia respecto a las últimas semanas, cuando la divisa recuperó parte de su tradicional atractivo como valor refugio durante los periodos de turbulencia en los mercados bursátiles. Si bien los funcionarios gubernamentales han enfatizado que es la velocidad y la imprecisión de los movimientos cambiarios, más que un nivel específico, lo que desencadena la intervención, una ruptura del nivel de 160 podría poner a prueba su tolerancia. Los analistas de mercado han visto este nivel como un posible punto de inflexión para las autoridades japonesas, ya que los movimientos que lo superaron provocaron intervenciones a principios de este año, y la moneda se recuperó con fuerza tras cruzar ese nivel a principios de septiembre. Ver más: ¿Por qué cayó el yen si el Banco de Japón subió las tasas? 5 respuestas y el efecto en América Latina A finales de julio, Tokio y Washington llevaron a cabo su primera intervención conjunta para respaldar el yen, lo que aumentó los riesgos para quienes apostaban en contra de la moneda. El país asiático intervino en el mercado de divisas tres veces durante el verano para apuntalar el yen, gastando un total de 15,4 billones de yenes (US$96.400 millones) en ese período. En septiembre, el presidente estadounidense Donald Trump expresó su preocupación por la debilidad del yen durante una reunión con la primera ministra japonesa Sanae Takaichi en Nueva York. Tanto la ministra de Finanzas, Satsuki Katayama, como el secretario del Tesoro estadounidense, Scott Bessent, han manifestado su disposición a intervenir nuevamente si fuera necesario. Bessent ha manifestado repetidamente su apoyo a un yen más fuerte y ha desafiado a los operadores a poner a prueba su determinación, mientras que Katayama ha advertido a los especuladores que está preparada para volver a intervenir en el mercado de divisas si fuera necesario. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 12 : Private equity firms CD&R and GTCR have dropped their pursuit of Global Payments, according to two people familiar with the matter. The buyout consortium walked away from talks to acquire the payments processor after exploring a potential deal over the past several weeks, the people said. The talks, which were in early stages, did not advance given the complexities of arranging a take-private of this scale, prompting the firms to put their efforts on hold, the people added. The end of the discussions removes one of the largest potential leveraged buyouts in the payments sector, at a time when buyout firms are grappling with higher borrowing costs and tougher financing markets for mega-deals. It is possible that CD&R and GTCR will resume the talks with Global Payments at a later date or another buyer for the company may emerge, the people said.

CD&R declined to comment. Global Payments and GTCR did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Atlanta-based Global Payments, which has a market value of about $26.4 billion, is one of the world's largest payments processors, helping merchants accept card and digital payments while also providing software and technology services to businesses. The company has been under pressure in recent years from slower growth in some of its business lines, intensifying competition and investor demands to improve profitability. Global Payments has already been reshaping its portfolio. In April 2025, it agreed to acquire Worldpay from FIS and private equity firm GTCR in a transaction valued at more than $24 billion, while simultaneously agreeing to sell its issuer-solutions business to FIS. The transactions were aimed at sharpening Global Payments' focus on merchant services and expanding its scale in payment processing. A takeover of Global Payments would have ranked among the largest private equity transactions attempted this year. But arranging financing for deals of that size remains challenging, particularly amid market volatility and lenders' scrutiny of leverage levels for large buyouts. Earlier this year, a consortium of Stripe and Advent International walked away from its pursuit of PayPal after submitting a bid valuing the payments company at more than $53 billion, Reuters reported.

item.title: 中国「独身の日」の売上高4.8％増 伸び率は25年から減速
item.description: [北京 １２日 ロイター] - データ提供会社の星図数据（Ｓｙｎｔｕｎ）は１２日、中国の「独身の日」セール期間の主要な...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国「独身の日」の売上高4.8％増　伸び率は25年から減速 1:59 配信

2026年11月11日、中国・上海で、JD.comの「独身の日」セールキャンペーン。 REUTERS/Go Nakamura（ロイター） [北京 １２日 ロイター] - データ提供会社の星図数据（Ｓｙｎｔｕｎ）は１２日、中国の「独身の日」セール期間の主要な電子商取引（ＥＣ）企業の合計売上高は前年から４．８％増の１兆７８００億元（約２６７０億ドル）になったとの推計を発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）を使ったツールや、ライブ配信などを活用してＡＩ関連製品などの販促活動を展開したものの、２０２５年の売上高の１４．２％増からは伸び率が減速した。

１０月７日から１１月１１日までを集計の対象とした。中国では、不動産市場の低迷の長期化や雇用への懸念などが支出を圧迫し、消費者心理が冷え込んでいる。商品の推薦から購入先への誘導、決済まで一貫して担うチャットボットの販売面への効果は、現時点では明らかではない。

アリババ・グループは、新たな技術や消費トレンドなどに関わる新興ブランドの業績を強調した。１０月１５日─２７日に、ＡＩ関連を含む立ち上げから３年以内の３３３のブランドが、各専門部門で１位になったと指摘した。

京東集団（ＪＤドットコム）によると、期間中に５０００万点を超えるＡＩ関連製品を販売し、３億件以上のサービス注文を獲得。ＡＩ搭載のパソコンやワークステーション、ＡＩメガネなどの取引額は前年から２倍以上に増え、大規模言語モデル用の「トークン」パッケージの販売は１０倍を超えたという。

アリババ傘下の「淘宝（タオバオ）」や「天猫（Ｔモール）」、ＪＤドットコムは、取引総額は公表していない。年間を通じて販促が大幅に増えており、独身の日の盛り上がりは以前ほどではないとの指摘もある。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 12 : The International Monetary Fund is closely monitoring volatility in AI equity valuations and the US political shift that could slow data center development, but says it is too early to tell whether investors are souring on the sector for the long term.  IMF spokesperson Julie Kozack told a regular press briefing that AI equity valuations remain exposed to a reassessment of the longer-term profitability of the technology. "That overall view that we have taken still remains the case," she said. The resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang sent the company's shares sharply lower on Thursday, dragging down the S&P 500 and Nasdaq indexes, but some major tech stocks rose, including Nvidia rival Advanced Micro Devices, Alphabet and Microsoft.  Asked about the impact on the AI sector from the stock gyrations, as well as pledges by newly elected Democratic governors to slow data center development, Kozack said: "We're of course are closely monitoring the most recent developments and their impact on equity markets, the economy, and financial stability, but at this point it's really too early to say whether there's going to be some broader reassessment of investment in AI technology and any broader reassessment of profitability and future productivity gains."

Kozack also said it was too early to determine any impact on US inflation pressures from possible shifts in AI investment "just based on what we've seen in the past hours, weeks, and days."  She said the IMF views the increased demand created by AI investment and data center construction as one of the two major contributors to US inflation, along with elevated energy prices caused by the Iran war and closure of the Strait of Hormuz.  The IMF believes that the Federal Reserve will still need to maintain restrictive US monetary policy to bring inflation back to its 2 per cent target, Kozack said.  "Our view is that a restrictive policy stance will be necessary going forward to support disinflation and bring inflation gradually back to target. We fully support the Fed's focus on price stability and its readiness to act as needed to bring inflation down," Kozack said. The Fed's policy-setting committee next meets on December 8-9.

Putin lets Europe join Ukraine peace talks, as Kyiv says Starshield disrupted again

Reuters

12 November, 2026 10:00 pm IST

Follow Us:

By Andrew Osborn and Maxim Rodionov MOSCOW, Nov 12 (Reuters) – President Vladimir Putin agreed on Thursday to let European representatives join the next round of Ukraine peace talks, a US envoy said, though the Russian leader said Washington must work with its European allies to understand if they want peace or war in Ukraine.

The move to give Europe a seat at the negotiating table at the next round of talks, which US envoy Steve Witkoff told reporters after the talks, is a breakthrough. But Putin’s comments underlined how difficult the negotiations could become, given sharp differences between Moscow and European capitals.

“The Europeans will join at the next meeting, which we consider to be a very important moment because they are our partners and it’s important to us that they take part,” Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin.

Show Full Article

But in a sign of renewed tensions, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy – who Witkoff and Kushner were expected to meet later in Dublin – said new restrictions were affecting the US-made satellite communications Kyiv uses on the battlefield, and that he found the US approach of discussing a new European security order with Russia “a bit strange”.

Zelenskiy voiced alarm after two days of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi earlier this week at which Kyiv and Moscow said there had been some progress but that major differences remained, including on territorial issues.

“So far we know very little (on the Starshield restrictions). But some things are already clear: if someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then it tells us where things are going,” said Zelenskiy.

The main outcome of the Abu Dhabi talks, the first direct US-mediated negotiations between Russia and Ukraine in nine months, was agreement on a major exchange of prisoners of war likely to take place in the coming weeks.

Serious unresolved issues remain however, including differences over territory – with Russia holding about one fifth of Ukraine and Kyiv refusing to give up the rest of the Donbas region in its east.

EU ROLE IN TALKS?

Kushner told Putin that Washington had detected what he called “a big change” in the European side and was confident that expanding peace talks to include the Europeans would not hinder progress.

Putin said Moscow had always been open to talking to the EU about Ukraine, but signalled serious outstanding differences.

“As far as the Europeans are concerned, we have never been opposed to engaging in dialogue with Europe, and we have never broken off that dialogue. It was they who broke off the dialogue with the Russian Federation,” he said.

He then warned that the European idea of sending Western troops into Ukraine once a peace deal was concluded would trigger a resumption of the war because Russia would see that as a threat to its own security.

“We would very much like you, gentlemen, and the US administration as a whole, to work with your European allies so that they can finally make up their minds as to what they want: peace or war in Ukraine,” said Putin.

Zelenskiy said disruptions to the Starshield satellite communications service were significant, affecting the entire front line and Russian-controlled parts of Ukraine. Starshield is the military version of SpaceX’s Starlink satellite communications service, and Ukraine suffered similar disruptions last month.

In a post on Telegram, Zelenskiy said that systemic restrictions were limiting the speed at which Starshield could be used. As a result, Ukrainian interceptors could not reach sufficient speed to down Russian jet-powered drones, he said.

PROPOSED AID MISSION

Putin told the US envoys that Russia was proposing a joint Russian-Ukrainian humanitarian mission to Kostiantynivka in eastern Ukraine which he said Moscow controlled, an assertion Ukraine has taken issue with in the past.

Putin said the mission could be modelled on an initiative that allowed residents to leave the Russian-controlled town of Oleshky in southeastern Ukraine at the end of last month and for aid to be brought in for those who chose to remain.

Russia needed five days to clear the area near Kostiantynivka of mines, Putin said, saying there were 400-500 residents of the city who were still there. The mission would allow the world to understand who controlled the city, he added.

Kyiv has previously expressed concerns that Moscow might wish to use ceasefires for such missions so that its military can regroup.

Moscow has not made major territorial gains this year, but has heavily attacked Ukrainian infrastructure and Kyiv has frequently struck Russian oil refineries with drones, causing fuel shortages over the summer, a problem which has resurfaced in some regions this week according to local officials.

Putin has shown no signs of being ready to moderate his territorial demands, which include a buffer zone in parts of Ukraine which Russia has not formally claimed as its own.

(Reporting by Reuters, Writing by Andrew Osborn, Editing by Timothy Heritage)

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 12 : US stocks reversed early losses to trade slightly higher on Thursday even as Nvidia shares fell following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation. The 10-year US Treasury yield climbed back above 5 per cent. Nvidia said Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO as the company looks for a permanent successor. Nvidia shares were last down about 4 per cent but off the day's lows. Huang's resignation raises questions about the chipmaker's future and the AI boom. The move follows news Huang had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for Beijing. Shares of competitor Advanced Micro Devices were up 7 per cent. Broadcom rose 5.4 per cent, while Intel was flat.

Chinese tech firms that use Nvidia chips for their AI models fell sharply. Alibaba was down 7.1 per cent in US trading, while Tencent dropped 2.6 per cent earlier. Some investors are concerned Washington may curb access to offshore data centers with the most advanced processors. INDEXES UP SLIGHTLY The three major US stock indexes, however, edged higher, with an index of semiconductors up 0.2 per cent after reversing early declines. A world stocks index was flat. "The market's absorbed this reasonably well. You notice some of Nvidia's losses have been offset by gains in competitors," said Peter Tuz, president of Chase Investment Counsel in Charlottesville, Virginia. "As far as Nvidia's future, there's a lot that remains unknown about this whole episode," he said. "Are we seeing the bottom today? Will there be more bad news coming out that will drive down the stock again? That's the existential question looking at Nvidia today. " The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 210.10 points, or 0.40 per cent, to 52,696.65, the S&P 500 gained 21.99 points, or 0.29 per cent, to 7,641.10 and the Nasdaq Composite added 79.16 points, or 0.31 per cent, to 25,545.34. MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe eased 0.02 points to 1,121.13. The pan-European STOXX 600 index was last up 0.23 per cent. It hit its first record high since August. US Treasury yields rose after US President Donald Trump said the US does not need a deal with Iran. The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes rose 7.73 basis points to 5.066 per cent.  Germany's 10-year Bund yield dipped. DOLLAR EXTENDS RECENT GAINS The US dollar index reached a fresh 19-month high as investors continued to weigh US rate increase expectations. Traders see a December hike from the Federal Reserve as likely. The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro,rose 0.26 per cent to 103.14, with the euro down 0.25 per cent at $1.1061. Against the Japanese yen, the dollar strengthened 0.08 per cent to 159.9. US crude rose 0.32 per cent to $86.81 a barrel and Brent climbed to $93.82 per barrel, up 1.14 per cent.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 対中半導体規制巡りラトニック長官に批判、エヌビディアＣＥＯ辞任で波紋
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 多くの米議員の間で、ラトニック米商務長官に対する批判が強まっている。トランプ政権が数十社の中国企業を米国の主要な貿易ブラックリストに追加するのを拒んでいることや、政府がエヌビディアの対中輸出を適切に監督していたかどうかが問題視されている。

ラトニック氏の対応に対する批判は、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が１２日に辞任する前から出ていたが、フアン氏の行動を巡る波紋が広がるにつれ、ラトニック氏が対中ＡＩ半導体の入手に対する規制に十分な措置を講じてこなかったという非難が高まっている。

マサチューセッツ州選出のウォーレン上院議員（民主党）は「ラトニック商務長官とジェフリー・ケスラー商務次官は、なぜ輸出規制の抜け穴をふさいでこなかったのかを説明し、われわれの先端技術が中国の軍事力を強化することのないよう、きょう直ちに行動を起こさなければならない」と主張した。

フアン氏は、両党の対中強硬派が中国による同技術へのアクセスを規制すべきだと絶えず批判する中、対中輸出の拡大を支持してきた。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ大統領は「同長官とその職務遂行能力に全幅の信頼を寄せている」と述べた。商務省は直ちにコメントしなかった。

米メディアのアクシオスは１１日、複数の高官の話として、ラトニック長官がエヌビディア製チップを中国へ横流しした疑いのある企業に対するトランプ大統領の取り締まりに歯止めをかけていたと報じていた。

item.title: トランプ氏、エヌビディア次期トップにアップルのクック氏推奨
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トランプ氏、エヌビディア次期トップにアップルのクック氏推奨 1:16 配信

アップルのティム・クック前ＣＥＯ（左）とエヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンＣＥＯ。5月14日、北京で撮影。REUTERS/Go Nakamura/Pool（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任のニュースを受け、アップルのティム・クック前ＣＥＯがフアン氏の後任にふさわしいとの考えを示した。

トランプ大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「素晴らしい仕事をしてきたエヌビディアのジェンセン・フアンＣＥＯが辞任した今、後任にふさわしい人物はただ一人、アップルのティム・クック氏だ」と投稿。「伝説が伝説に代わる！」と述べた。

クック氏は９月、１５年間にわたりアップルＣＥＯを務めた後に退任し、現在はアップルの執行会長を務めている。

エヌビディアはこの日、フアンＣＥＯが辞任すると発表した。フアン氏を巡っては、中国のスパイとの疑惑が持たれている女性や、社内幹部との不倫行為が取り沙汰されていた。

ロイター 関連リンク コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず アングル：アップル初の折り畳みｉＰｈｏｎｅ、強気価格が突きつける「誰のためのスマホか」 アングル：クック氏からターナス氏へ、アップル新体制にＡＩと「脱中国」の試練 焦点：ＡＩ時代のアップル、過去の「強み」は足かせとなるか コラム：クック氏退任のアップル、ＡＩ時代でｉＰｈｏｎｅ依存脱却なるか 11/13(金) 1:16 最終更新 ロイター

Nov 12 : SpaceX said on Thursday it plans to invest more than $74 billion in two supercomputing campuses, its Starbase site in Texas and in Cochise County, Arizona, expanding its AI computing ambitions alongside rocket and satellite businesses. The AI segment of the Elon Musk-led company, which went public in June, generated more than half of its revenue in the third quarter, highlighting how far the business has moved beyond rockets and Starlink satellite internet. SpaceX expects to spend more than $24 billion on the Starbase site and roughly $50 billion on the Arizona campus, it said in a statement. The Arizona campus, which needs approval from Cochise County, would create about 5,500 construction jobs and 1,000 permanent jobs.

SpaceX said it was working with local electric cooperatives and the project could cut bills for cooperative members by up to 20 per cent. It said the campus would use dry cooling, with no planned industrial groundwater use. The facility, however, faces some opposition. A petition with 2,400 signatures has asked officials to deny the permit, and a county public hearing is set for December. The Starbase facility would generate its own electricity rather than draw from the public grid. A city notice this week showed plans for a gas-fired power plant and supercomputing facility on about 444 acres. The Starbase City Commission is due to consider a property tax abatement for the project on December 9. SpaceX said the Texas project had generated more than 3,000 construction jobs and would support more than 500 permanent jobs once operational.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 12 : US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that former Apple Inc Chief Executive Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia. "NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple," Trump said on social media. "A Legend replaces a Legend!" he added. Cook stepped down after a 15-year stint as Apple's CEO in September and is now executive chairman at the iPhone-maker. Apple and Cook did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Last year, Cook presented Trump with a custom US-made plaque mounted on a 24-carat gold stand commemorating Apple's "American Manufacturing Program", after saying it would invest an additional $100 billion in domestic manufacturing. Huang resigned as CEO and a member of the board on Thursday after reports said he had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for Beijing. Nvidia has announced that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Trump, who has maintained close ties with top US tech executives in his second term, said on Monday that he had spoken to Huang and the CEO told him that he did not know the woman linked to him was allegedly a spy. Huang is one of Trump's closest allies in Silicon Valley, and the relationship between the two dates to at least 2025. Over the past two years, Huang has repeatedly voiced support for the administration's agenda and become a regular presence in Washington as Nvidia sought to sell advanced chips to the Chinese market.

item.title: 米国、ＡＩによる雇用市場の「深刻な短期的混乱」に備えを＝バーＦＲＢ理事
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１２日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国、ＡＩによる雇用市場の「深刻な短期的混乱」に備えを＝バーＦＲＢ理事 0:52 配信

写真はバーＦＲＢ理事。4月14日、米ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Evan Vucci（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -  米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１２日、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって雇用市場に「深刻な短期的混乱」が生じるリスクに米国は備えるべきだとの見解を示した。ＡＩの普及速度によっては、労働者が大規模に職を失い、投資家に有利な形で格差が拡大する可能性があるとした。

バー氏はイエール大学での講演原稿で、一部セクターでＡＩが労働の代替となっている兆候がみられており、変化が急速に進めば「大きな混乱が生じる可能性がある」と述べた。一方、ＡＩ企業間の競争により、この技術への幅広いアクセスが可能となっているため、これまでのところ労働者の解雇はほとんど起きていないと述べた。

その上で、ＡＩの影響については依然として不透明だと指摘。その帰結は、ＡＩ企業間の競争が今後も続き、この強力な新技術がインターネットが時間の経過とともにそうであったように「安価かつ広く普及したコモディティー（商品）となり、その恩恵が広く共有される」ようになるかどうかに大きくかかっていると述べた。

バー氏はまた、労働所得の割合が低下していると指摘した上で、ＡＩが資本収益率をさらに押し上げるかどうかは未解明の問題だと述べた。

バー氏の発言は、ＡＩの影響を予測するものではなく、ＡＩがもたらす社会的な緊張への備えを提言するものだ。また、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が任命した作業部会（タスクフォース）が、この新たな技術が経済に及ぼす影響を検討するために１６日にサンフランシスコで開く公開討論会を控える中での発言となった。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国「独身の日」、ＡＩが買い物主導　消費喚起なるかは未知数 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 11/13(金) 0:52 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ＮＹ建物倒壊の死者8人に、消防士含む17人負傷＝市長
item.description:
Maria Tsvetkova Steve Gorman
[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Tsvetkova　Steve Gorman

[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク市のマムダニ市長は１２日、同市ブルックリンで１１日に倒壊したアパートの死者が８人になったと発表した。また、捜索活動に当たっていた消防士３人を含む少なくとも１７人が負傷したと明らかにした。

市消防局によると、ブルックリンのフラットブッシュ地区にある３階建ての建物は現地時間１１日午後４時（日本時間１２日午前６時）ごろ倒壊した。１９３０年築の集合住宅で、掘削工事が行われていた隣接地の建設現場に崩れ落ちた。原因は調査中。また、倒壊時に何人が在宅していたかは現時点で分かっていない。

地元メディアは、倒壊から約２時間半後、妊婦を含む少なくとも４人ががれきの下から救出されたと報じた。

市消防局長は、確認されている被害者に子ども７人が含まれるとした一方、死者が子どもか大人かについては明言を避けた。

item.title: 米国株式市場・序盤＝ＡＩ関連株急落、エヌビディアＣＥＯ辞任で資金供給懸念
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター］ - １２日序盤の米国株式市場では、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が大幅に下落した。米半導体大...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場・序盤＝ＡＩ関連株急落、エヌビディアＣＥＯ辞任で資金供給懸念 0:30 配信

2018年1月7日、米国ネバダ州ラスベガスで撮影。エヌビディアのジェンセン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）　REUTERS/Rick Wilking/File Photo（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　１２日　ロイター］ - １２日序盤の米国株式市場では、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が大幅に下落した。米半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の辞任を受け、資金調達や規制への懸念ですでに動揺していたＡＩ業界に新たなリスクが浮上した。

ＡＩ産業の中核を担う同社は、自社の半導体を使ったインフラ整備に資金を供給している。この戦略には資金の循環を巡って厳しい目が向けられている。

エヌビディア株は一時１２％超下落し、時価総額は５０００億ドル超が消失する勢いとなった。その後は下げ幅を縮小し、約７．５％安で推移した。

セミス・トレーディングのパートナー兼株式取引共同責任者、ジョー・サルッツィ氏は「エヌビディアは『ＡＩの銀行』と呼ばれてきた。今回の事態で資金供給から一歩引かざるを得なくなれば、資金を必要とする小規模企業への供給が途絶えるのか。答えはまだ分からない」と述べた。

エヌビディアが出資する「ネオクラウド」企業のコアウィーブは９．１％下落した。他のネオクラウド銘柄では、ＩＲＥＮやアプライド・デジタルも下落。ネビウスは、２０２６年の売上高が従来予想レンジの下限になるとの見通しを示し、１６．２％下落した。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は１．３％下落した。

フアン氏が６月に「次の時価総額１兆ドル企業」と呼んだマーベル・テクノロジーは３．８％下落。エヌビディアとのクラウド向けＡＩ半導体取引を拡大している大規模クラウド事業者のオラクルは２．６％安となった。

メモリー半導体メーカーのマイクロン・テクノロジーは２．５％下落。データストレージ企業のサンディスクとウエスタン・デジタルはそれぞれ６％、３．７％下落した。光関連製品メーカーのルメンタムとコヒレント、ＡＩサーバーメーカーのデルは３─５．１％下落した。

建設機械・発電設備メーカーのキャタピラーと電力会社ビストラは、それぞれ約０．５％下落した。

一方、ＡＩ半導体を手掛け、エヌビディアと競合するＡＭＤとブロードコムは、それぞれ３．７％、５．６％上昇した。エヌビディアの混乱が競合他社に商機をもたらすとの期待が支えた。

他の大規模クラウド事業者では、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コム、マイクロソフトも０．８─２．７％上昇した。

item.title: トランプ氏、メキシコに関税倍増を警告 移民の流入阻止しなければ
item.description:
Bo Erickson Susan Heavey
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Susan Heavey

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、先週の米中間選挙後に１０００人超の移民が米国を目指して北上しているとし、メキシコがこれを阻止しなければ同国への関税を倍増させるとし、移民の入国は認めないと警告した。

トランプ氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で「また始まった！」とし、「彼ら（移民）は受け入れられない！メキシコは今すぐ彼らを止めなければならない。そうしなければ、メキシコへの関税を直ちに倍増させる。メキシコ、テキサス州知事、テキサス州の非常にリベラルな新知事、わが偉大な国境警備隊、そして米移民・税関捜査局（ＩＣＥ）にはその旨を通知済みだ。一切容赦はしない！」と強調した。

米中間選挙での民主党勝利を受け、米国の移民政策がより寛容になるかもしれないとの期待を背景に、１０００人を超える移民が１１日、メキシコ南部を集団で北上。チアパス州政府筋によると、この集団は多くの家族連れを含む約１５００人規模とみられる。

メキシコ政府当局者からは、直ちには反応がなかった。

item.title: 「小幅で段階的な」米利上げ必要、インフレ抑制へ＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
「小幅で段階的な」米利上げ必要、インフレ抑制へ＝クリーブランド連銀総裁 11/12 23:58 配信

米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁。2025年4月24日、ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Segar（ロイター） Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１２日、インフレ抑制には短期金利の引き上げが依然として必要であるとの見解を示した。この発言は、１２月初旬に開かれる連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での０．５％ポイントの利上げに反対する慎重な姿勢を示唆するものとみられる。

ハマック総裁はオハイオ州立大学での講演で、「インフレ率を目標の２％に回帰させるには、金融政策を引き締め的なスタンスに転換する必要があるとみている」と指摘。来月のＦＯＭＣで０．５％ポイントの利上げが行われる可能性について、同氏は「私の見解では、小幅な利上げをより頻繁に、段階的に進める方が、企業や家計にとって対応しやすい」との見方を示した。

またハマック氏は、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は二つの責務のうち雇用面では非常にうまくやっている一方、インフレ面で数年にわたり目標を達成できていないと指摘。「直近のインフレ指標は物価上昇圧力の広がりを示している」とした上で、高インフレの一因として実需圧力を指摘した。

さらに、ＦＲＢが後手に回っているとは考えておらず、もしそうなればより積極的な対応を検討するとの考えも示した。

FAST

HYDERABAD, Nov 12 : US retailer Costco sees room to expand its technology presence in India beyond Hyderabad as it accelerates international growth, with its first global capability centre playing a key role in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, a top executive said. The Hyderabad centre, which employs more than 70 people, supports global operations and is expected to grow to several hundred staff over the next five to six years, Javier Polit, Costco's chief information and digital officer, told Reuters on Thursday. He did not give a specific hiring target. "We're going to grow our business internationally at a greater velocity than we have been in the past. So there'll be more presence in this geography for sure," Polit said, adding that India was already playing a key role in the retailer's growth plans.  AI has delivered productivity gains of up to 60 per cent in some technology projects, Polit said, prompting Costco to build more tools in India for global deployment, including a Hyderabad-developed geofencing tool that identifies customers approaching stores to speed check-in and checkout.

The Hyderabad centre will also support data and analytics, business software and digital advertising operations, Polit said. Over time, Costco expects the mix of its technology workforce to shift to about 75 per cent employees and 25 per cent contractors, from roughly an even split today, as it builds more in-house engineering and technology capabilities, Polit said. Costco set up its Hyderabad GCC with support from consulting firm ANSR, a move Reuters reported last year could eventually employ about 1,000 people. Global capability centres, once used mainly by multinationals to cut costs, now drive higher-value work in areas such as technology, finance, product development and research. Costco, one of the world's largest retailers, operates a membership-only warehouse club business across North America, Europe and Asia. The company has built a loyal customer base through its low-price, bulk-buying model and has continued to expand globally amid resilient consumer demand.

Source: Reuters

item.title: トランプ氏、バンス氏の民主党都市の汚職対策に期待 「イランとの合意不要」
item.description: [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、民主党が首長を務める都市における犯罪や汚職にバンス副大統領が「全精力を注ぐ」ことを望むとの考えを示した。その上で、その取り組みはイランとの合意よりも多くの資金を節約できる可能性があると述べた。

トランプ氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で「こうした大規模な犯罪行為を是正すれば、われわれの予算はすぐに均衡するだろう。汚職は民主党指導部の血に流れている」と指摘。「われわれにイランとの合意は必要ない。そうした時代はとうに過ぎ去った。われわれは彼らの資金、数千億ドルを押さえており、（ホルムズ）海峡も掌握している！」と述べた。

対イラン紛争の解決に向けて尽力してきたバンス氏は１１月４日、共和党が中間選挙で民主党に大敗したことを受け、トランプ氏が進めた対イラン戦争と距離を置く姿勢を示した。バンス氏は、その意義に疑問を呈するとともに、民主党に議会支配を許した有権者の厳しい審判は全面的にイラン戦争に原因があったとの認識を示し、過去に戦争終結を勧告したことについても「妥当な助言だった」と述べた。

バンス氏は２０２８年の大統領選で有力候補と目されている。

item.title: 〔情報ＢＯＸ〕エヌビディア暫定ＣＥＯ、クレス氏の横顔
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
〔情報ＢＯＸ〕エヌビディア暫定ＣＥＯ、クレス氏の横顔 11/12 23:28 配信

エヌビディアは１２日、フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ、写真）が暫定ＣＥＯに就くと発表した。　Nvidia/Handout via REUTERS（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任し、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）が暫定ＣＥＯに就くと発表した。以下はクレス氏の横顔。

＜２０１３年からＣＦＯ＞クレス氏は２０１３年９月に執行副社長兼ＣＦＯとしてエヌビディアに入社し、以来この職を務めてきた。四半期決算説明会ではフアン氏とともに登壇してきた。同社の売上高は、クレス氏が入社した会計年度には４１億３０００万ドルだったが、２０２６会計年度には２１５９億ドルに達した。

＜エヌビディア以前の経歴＞エヌビディアに入る前、クレス氏はテキサス・インスツルメンツで８年間財務関連の職を務め、その後１９９７年から２０１０年までマイクロソフトに勤務した。マイクロソフトでは２００６年にサーバー・ツール部門のＣＦＯに就き、同部門の財務戦略、計画、報告を担当した。

２０１０年にはシスコに移り、ビジネステクノロジー・オペレーションズ財務部門の上級副社長兼ＣＦＯとして、財務戦略と事業開発を担当した。その後、２０１３年にエヌビディアへ移った。

＜学歴＞米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に提出されたエヌビディアの年次報告書によると、クレス氏はアリゾナ大学で金融学の学士号を、サザンメソジスト大学で経営学修士（ＭＢＡ）を取得している。

フォーチュン誌が２０２４年に報じたところでは、クレス氏は大手テクノロジー企業で約２５年間財務関連の職を務めた後にエヌビディアに入社した。同氏はフォーチュン誌に対し、２０１３年に入社した当時、エヌビディアはそれまで働いた中で最も小さな会社だったと語った。

＜契約条件＞会社の委任状によると、エヌビディアの執行役員は特定の雇用期間を定めない任意雇用で、個別の雇用契約、退職金契約、支配権変更に伴う契約は結んでいない。エヌビディアは過去の提出書類で、同業他社の多くはこうした契約を提供していると説明していた。

規制当局への提出書類によると、クレス氏の報酬には譲渡制限付き株式ユニット（ＲＳＵ）が含まれ、その中には４年間かけて権利が確定する２０２６年３月付与分がある。

＜資産＞フォーブス誌は、自力で財をなした米国女性に関する２０２６年版ランキングで、クレス氏を３２位に位置付けている。同氏が保有するエヌビディア株式の評価額は１１日終値時点で約７億５０００万ドルとなり、株価が１０月にピークを付けた際の１０億ドル超から減少した。

WASHINGTON, Nov 12 : The Republican chair of the Senate Intelligence Committee urged US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to bar Chinese memory chip producer CXMT from the US market and deny it access to American technologies. Senator Tom Cotton said in a letter Thursday that CXMT "poses a growing risk to our economic prosperity and military superiority. The US must take action to prevent CXMT from gaining a stronger foothold in the global market."

Source: Reuters

Warby Parker bets on Google AI glasses for growth, but privacy fears still loom

Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear glasses are displayed during an event in New York City, US, November 9, 2026. REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 12 : Warby Parker is entering the smart glasses market in partnership with Google and Samsung, betting that demand for the artificial intelligence wearables will balloon in the coming years. But the New York-based fashion brand, known for its affordable eyewear, is also seeking to head off privacy concerns that have weighed on existing producers of the glasses, most of which embed small cameras allowing wearers to record their surroundings without taking out their phone. The Warby Parker glasses are broadly similar to Meta smart glasses already available from Ray-Ban and Oakley maker EssilorLuxottica, which have faced regulatory scrutiny from Norway to Australia. Also like the Meta glasses, they will connect to an AI assistant, in this case Google's Gemini, for everything from directions to language translation.   The big difference from existing versions on the market is the privacy framework embedded in the glasses from the outset, Warby Parker Co-CEO Neil Blumenthal told Reuters.

Alphabet's Google will not use visuals captured with the glasses to train its AI. The glasses will bar facial recognition of bystanders. And a small white notification light on the front of the glasses automatically turns on when a user starts recording video. Shoppers will start placing pre-orders from Warby Parker on Thursday. Ray-Ban's Meta glasses still dominate, representing 81.3 per cent of AI glasses shipments in the first half of this year, according to tech research group Omdia. But brands from Warby Parker to luxury group Kering — poised to release glasses also in partnership with Google — are looking to gain a foothold. Global AI glasses shipments more than doubled in the first half of 2026 from a year ago, though growth has slowed since the second half of last year, Omdia data shows. Meta's AI glasses also include a camera notification light on the front, a Meta spokesperson said, adding that input from safety experts helped inform the privacy features on its glasses. CATEGORY CONFRONTS PRIVACY RISKS Optimism that Warby Parker's "intelligent eyewear" plan will prove to be a major growth engine has helped its shares rally by nearly 40 per cent this year, outperforming a 10 per cent gain in the S&P 500. The company expects an addition of several percentage points to fourth-quarter revenue growth from the new wearable technology, executives said on an earnings call earlier this month. "As long as the tools provide utility to customers, then we'll be successful," Blumenthal said. While the core optical backdrop remains soft, smart glasses are poised to be an "increasingly important driver" of Warby Parker's growth outlook, analysts at TD Cowen wrote in a research note last week.  Still, concerns about privacy could slow their pace of growth. One of Britain's biggest pub chains has restricted the use of the frames, Norway's government is planning a temporary ban on the use of AI glasses in certain locations, and Australia is considering barring the use of camera-equipped smart glasses in government workplaces. GOOGLE AIMS TO REBUILD TRUST Juston Payne, who leads extended reality products at Google, acknowledged that public skepticism could be a risk to growth. "This is an area where, understandably, trust was lost," he told Reuters at a demo for the Warby Parker glasses in New York. Google says it will embed extensive privacy guardrails into the devices to prevent tampering with the recording indicator light; redact people's faces from video footage before it is sent to Gemini; and ban targeted advertising on the glasses. "We are going to change this conversation," Payne said. "We are trying to raise the bar." But it remains to be seen whether those measures will ease concern about widespread surveillance, if the glasses become ubiquitous. "I'm certainly happy to hear that (video footage is) not automatically fed into AI systems for training," said Calli Schroeder, who leads the AI and human rights program at the Electronic Privacy Information Center, an advocacy group. "But that still leaves open: a stranger has footage of my kid on their phone. That's concerning no matter how you phrase it."

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米新規失業保険申請9000件増の20万件、労働市場なお底堅く推移
item.description: [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１２日発表した１１月７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請9000件増の20万件、労働市場なお底堅く推移 11/12 23:11 配信

2025年8月1日、米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１２日発表した１１月７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比９０００件増の２０万件となった。増加したものの、労働市場の底堅さと整合する水準にとどまった。 ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１９万５０００件だった。

申請件数は９月中旬以降、２０万件以下で推移しており、７月中旬に付けた１９６９年以来の低水準である１８万９０００件に近い水準を維持していることから、労働市場が逼迫しつつある可能性が高まっている。

賃金の伸びが緩やかなことから、一部のエコノミストは労働市場が再び逼迫しているとは見ていない。一方、退職の増加やトランプ大統領政権による移民取り締まり強化を背景とした労働力人口の縮小が、歴史的な低水準の申請件数の主な要因だとする見方もある。

シティグループのエコノミスト、ベロニカ・クラーク氏は「労働力人口の全般的な縮小は、失業保険を申請する労働者の数が減っていることを意味する可能性がある」と指摘。「もちろん、これは依然として低い失業率と整合性がある。継続受給件数の推移を見ると、２０２７年初頭までのデータで失業率が４．０％付近に向けてさらに低下する可能性さえ示唆されている」と述べた。

１０月３１日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万件減の１６９万７０００件だった。ただ、継続受給件数には、新卒者や就労歴がほとんどない、あるいは全くない人々など、一部の失業者は含まれていない。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：米財政運営巡る政治対立リスク、民主党勝利で市場が注目 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 11/12(木) 23:11 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ辞任、ＡＩ業界に影響も 暫定トップにＣＦＯ
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任すると発表し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディアのフアンＣＥＯ辞任、ＡＩ業界に影響も　暫定トップにＣＦＯ 11/12 23:01 配信

エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンCEO。7月16日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada/File Photo（ロイター） [１２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは１２日、ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が辞任すると発表した。フアン氏を巡っては、中国のスパイとみられている女性や、社内幹部との不倫行為が取り沙汰されていた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームの主要な原動力の一つであるエヌビディア率いるフアン氏の辞任によって、ＡＩ業界は最も影響力のある推進者の一人を失うことになる。フアン氏が中国市場へのアクセス維持に尽力してきたことや、トランプ米大統領との緊密な関係を踏まえると、同氏の辞任は米国の半導体輸出政策や、より広範なＡＩエコシステムにも影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

また、同氏が時価総額約４兆ドル企業へと育て上げたエヌビディアの後継者を巡る憶測も広がっている。

エヌビディアは後任ＣＥＯの選定に着手し、社内外から候補者を検討するとした。後任選びを進める間、コレット・クレス最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）が暫定ＣＥＯを務める。

投資家やアナリストの間では、フアン氏辞任前すでに、クレス氏と同社のベテランエンジニアであるイアン・バック氏が社内の有力後継候補として浮上していた。

米株式市場では、エヌビディア株は一時約１２％急落し、相場全体の重しとなった。その後は下げ幅を縮小し、約５％安で推移した。アナリストは、押し目買いが入ったことで下げ渋っていると指摘。それでも時価総額は約２０００億ドル減少する見通しだ。

競合のアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）とブロードコムはそれぞれ約６％上昇した。

クレス暫定ＣＥＯは従業員向けのメモで、「取締役会、経営陣、そして私自身、極めて困難な時期にあると認識している」と述べた上で、エヌビディアが米太平洋時間１８日午前９時（日本時間１９日午前２時）に会議を開催すると明らかにした。

ＣＮＢＣによると、クレス氏は同日中にも経営陣を招集する見通し。また、フアン氏は今月下旬の米感謝祭前に議会で証言することに同意したという。

フアン氏はＣＥＯに加え、社長および取締役も辞任する。同氏はエヌビディアの共同創業者で、約３．６１％の株式を保有する第４位の株主でもある。

また、同社取締役で米半導体設計大手シノプシスの元ＣＥＯであるハービー・ジョーンズ氏が、同社初の取締役会会長に就任する。

クリアブリッジ・インベストメンツのポートフォリオマネジャー、マイケル・フェルドマン氏は「リスクは、エヌビディアが突然技術ロードマップを失うことではない。ロードマップは今後数年間、おおむね見通すことができる。リスクは実行力だ。フアン氏は極めて複雑なシステムのけん引役だった」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「素晴らしい仕事をしてきたエヌビディアのジェンセン・フアンＣＥＯが辞任した今、後任にふさわしい人物はただ一人、アップルのティム・クック氏だ」と投稿。「伝説が伝説に代わる！」と述べた。

フアン氏を巡っては、シンガポール企業メガスピード元幹部の中国人実業家アリス・フアン氏との不倫疑惑が浮上。米情報機関は同氏について、中国企業へのエヌビディア製半導体の流通を手助けしていたとみている。その後、フアン氏が直属の部下でヘルスケア部門担当バイスプレジデントのキンバリー・パウエル氏とも不倫関係にあったと報じられたことを受け、エヌビディアの取締役会は１１日に会合を開き、同氏の解任を検討していた。

また、情報筋２人の情報によると、フアン氏は別の従業員とも親密な関係にあったという。

フアン氏の辞任は、トランプ政権内にも波紋が及ぶ可能性がある。関係者２人はロイターに対し、ホワイトハウス高官らが、ラトニック商務長官を解任すべきかどうか協議していると明らかにした。ラトニック長官を巡っては、トランプ政権が数十社の中国企業を米国の主要な貿易ブラックリストに追加するのを拒んできたとして、議員から批判が強まっていた。

また、ジョンソン下院議長は、「フアン氏の後任に適切な人物が選ばれることが極めて重要だ」とし、中国への半導体輸出制限について、議会内で合意が形成されつつあるとの認識を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国「独身の日」、ＡＩが買い物主導　消費喚起なるかは未知数 アングル：米債券市場、ＡＩ関連債への熱冷める　政策瀬踏みムードに アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 アングル：世界市場は既にぜい弱、ＡＩにもひび割れ 11/13(金) 5:10 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down
item.description: Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia, will not remain on the board.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid deepening scandal, leaving AI chip giant at crossroads

Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO. Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia, will not remain on the board.

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang looks on during the NVIDIA GTC global AI conference in San Jose, California, US, Mar 17, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Carlos Barria)

12 Nov 2026 10:01PM (Updated: 13 Nov 2026 04:01AM)

FAST

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down on Thursday (Nov 12) after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy, plunged the chipmaker into crisis and sent shockwaves across an AI industry he helped bankroll. Huang's exit caps a tumultuous week for Nvidia , one of the major engines behind the AI boom, and could have far-reaching consequences for US chip export policy and the broader AI ecosystem, given the ex-CEO's push to preserve access to the Chinese market, as well as his close ties with US President Donald Trump. The crisis has threatened to implicate some Trump administration members, including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who is facing growing questions over the administration's oversight of chip sales to China, particularly as both he and Huang pushed for relaxing those sales despite scrutiny from longtime China hawks in both parties. The Commerce Department did not immediately comment. Senior White House officials are discussing whether Lutnick should be pushed out, two people familiar with the situation told Reuters on Thursday.
